text.characters: Hi, I hope you’re doing well. I’m also caring for a loved one and wanted to connect with someone who understands. How have things been going for you lately?
It’s been a bit overwhelming lately, to be honest. Some days are harder than others.
I understand… I had a similar situation last week. Here are a few photos of how I set up a calm space at home.
Oh, that looks really peaceful. I might try something like that.
Also, this short video really helped me understand how to handle stressful moments.
Thank you so much for sharing. This really means a lot to me.
